description: Gives an edit job a name (its title), in any status: a draft, one that is being cut, one in review or posted. The name shows in the Edits queue and on the job's page. Only the title changes; the status, the plan and the sort order stay as they were.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: edit_job_rename
title: Rename an edit
